acceptance_rule: Vanilla B0 and patched no-block binary masks must be exactly equal for every object-frame.
The admitted object must remain exactly equal between patched no-block and selective block for every frame.
All objects must be exactly equal on the first block decision frame.
The blocked object must differ on at least one later frame.
Selective execution must report nonzero masked spatial and pointer tokens.
